desk-look passes the plugin directory's policy check again.

- The directory refused 0.59.1 with `MOD_CAPABILITY_USE_NOT_PLAIN` on the tasks panel, which hands `$` to the top-level `agentRow` helper: the activity panel declared a local function of the same name, so the call could not be matched to the top-level one. The activity panel's helper is now `turnAgentRow`; nothing changes on screen

## Install

```
/plugin install desk-look --marketplace KyongSik-Yoon/cc-desktop-mod
/plugin install desk-asana@cc-desktop-mod
/plugin install desk-slack@cc-desktop-mod
```

Already installed: `/desk-update` (or `claude plugin update desk-look`), then `/reload-plugins`.
